content_standards.text: Understand the physical features and life processes of living things and use this understanding to classify them

indicators.text: Classify animals into insects, birds, mammals and reptiles
Know life processes of animals (movement, nutrition and reproduction)

content_standards.text: Understand the differences between living things and things which have never been alive

indicators.text: Describe the physical appearance of different types of plants (trees, shrubs, climbing, creeping)
Describe the physical features of mammals, reptiles, insects and amphibians

content_standards.text: Know the uses of materials in our environment

indicators.text: Identify the uses of common materials (e.g. wood, metal, plastic, glass, fabric)
Suggest suitable materials for specific purposes

content_standards.text: Understand mixtures, their types, components and ways of separating them into their components

indicators.text: Identify a liquid-liquid mixture and describe how to separate its components
Describe the ways of separating insoluble solids from liquids

content_standards.text: Recognise that some events in our environment occur recurrently

indicators.text: Demonstrate understanding of cyclic movements in the environment
Describe the water cycle

content_standards.text: Recognise the relationship between the earth and the sun

indicators.text: Identify the objects in the sky during day and night
Describe the changes that occur from day to night

content_standards.text: Show an understanding of the roles of condensation, evaporation, transpiration and precipitation in the hydrological (water) cycle

indicators.text: Demonstrate the process of evapotranspiration
Describe the water cycle in the local environment

content_standards.text: Recognise water and air as important natural resources

indicators.text: Demonstrate ways of making water safe for use
Describe ways of keeping air clean in our environment

content_standards.text: Show an understanding of the life cycles of plants and animals

indicators.text: Describe the life cycle of a maize plant
Describe the life cycle of a frog

content_standards.text: Show an understanding of metamorphosis in animals

indicators.text: Describe the life cycle of a butterfly
Describe the life cycle of a chicken
